formal_reference: No numeric answer key. Scoring consumes an evaluator-provided trusted review bound to the submitted answer, evidence bundle and public question.

host_replay.oracle: not applicable: the task declares no reference solution and is Agent-only
host_replay.review: the host helper validates a frozen completed Harbor trial and injects review documents only through the separate verifier environment; native Harbor trial regrade produces PASS, FAIL, REVIEW_REQUIRED or ERROR

notes: A missing review produces REVIEW_REQUIRED with no reward; a malformed or mismatched trusted review produces ERROR and clears any stale reward. Host regrade uses tests/_support/harbor_review.py prepare then score and binds result, lock, manifest, task inputs, answer and evidence bytes.
A protocol_fixture only tests the review connection and always remains REVIEW_REQUIRED without reward; it is not a scientific review or scientific score.
The binding records the source trial checksum separately from current regrade input hashes; Harbor source locks do not record the historical runtime image digest, so image_id_status is NOT_RECORDED.
Schema v2 may nominate an identifiable numerical claim; the verifier reads the named CSV member and independently refits the attenuation length, including the declared length-unit conversion.
A numerical mismatch is a candidate FAIL; absent, malformed, non-identifiable or poorly fitted data are REVIEW_REQUIRED/INCONCLUSIVE, never a scientific failure.
The agent receives no case-specific scientific inputs, may use internet research, and the verifier runs offline; delivery coverage for this case remains partial.
